name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Add a **bold, full-width focus ring** (4px, 2:1 contrast ratio) on all interactive elements.

This ensures keyboard users see clear focus at a glance, meeting WCAG 2.2’s 2:1 minimum contrast for focus indicators. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings may feel heavier in dense UIs, but clarity outweighs minimal visual bulk.

name: Reader
text: Ramp’s bold ring risks a siren effect for keyboard users—it screams “error” or “alert” when it’s just navigation. A 4px ring also bleeds into dense layouts, crowding touch targets on mobile. Swap to a 2px ring with 3:1 contrast; test it with Playwright MCP’s keyboard nav suite and user feedback to settle the argument.
